title: Vibrant Earthy Egyptian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and earthy Egyptian lentil stew featuring shichimi-togarashi and katsuramuki-cut vegetables, perfect for a hangover cure, made in a copper pot. This Whole30-friendly dish is a great option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a copper pot over medium heat.
Add the katsuramuki-cut onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the katsuramuki-cut carrots and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the red lentils, shichimi-togarashi, cumin, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
